digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend adapter and seam architecture
propositions: ADR 0035 asserts the first real second backend (GitHub adapter) is out of scope, but epic e369 lands Jira Data Center as a second backend ahead of GitHub, falsifying that claim in three locations (diagram comment, prose, and Decision section)

TicketTransport declares six members while the reconciler's actual call sites reach for twenty-one distinct members across client/transport receivers, with twelve members absent from DC transport and absent from all Protocols, causing silent failures and runtime crashes despite passing contract suite and unit tests

RemoteRef.instance is presented as the mechanism for distinguishing deployments but is never constructed in production code, existing only in dataclass definition and test helpers, creating a gap between intended design and actual implementation
The documented user guide commands for selecting DC backend and installing the jira-datacenter extra have never been executed against a real instance to verify the guide's correctness

ADR 0035's claim that the contract suite certifies a backend is conditional on the port being complete and typed, since unannotated transport parameters prevent mypy from enforcing completeness and mask gaps until live execution
